history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: NHS and Social Services: Conditions of Employment
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Health and Social Care, what estimate she has made of costs of the Employment Rights Act for (a) the NHS and (b) the social care sector.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: NHS and Social Services: Zero Hours Contracts
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Health and Social Care, what assessment she has made of the implications of the zero-hours contract provisions in the Employment Rights Act for staff and employers in (a) the NHS (b) the social care sector.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Zero Hours Contracts
history.questionText: To ask the Minister for the Cabinet Office, whether her Department has the data in ONS table EMP17: People in employment on zero hours contracts, tab 6, at a sub-sector level for any of the sectors shown.
history.answeringBodyName: Cabinet Office

history.heading: Zero Hours Contracts
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade, whether his Department has (a) survey and (b) other data estimating the number of people with a zero-hours contract for whom this contract is not their primary employment.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

history.heading: Zero Hours Contracts: Hospitals

history.answeringBodyName: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade
